device.type: DVB-S2 Full HD compact satellite receiver
device.soc: ALi C3503C (chip word 0x3503C000, SDK chip code 0x10050, OTP product 5)

source.author: Ferguson
source.note: Archive A53_20160602_V1.30B8.zip from the Ferguson Ariva 53 directory on satedu.cba.pl; fetched 2026-11-07.

simulator.note: Boots as the single-CPU C3503 family (chips/c3503.py, run_dump_a53_130b8_app_starts.py, chip word 0x3503C000 -> SDK chip code 0x10050): its boot-ROM bootloader inherits $sp = 0x9FE07F00 from the boot ROM, calibrates DDR delay from the ring-oscillator count in 0xB8000300 ("RingOSDelay=296.29600(ns)"), prints "CRC Check Result : Pass", and unpacks the maincode ("V1.30B8*") to 0x80000200.  Passes the C3503C (0x10050) / OTP product 5 board check, initializes the internal DVB-S2 demodulator at 0xB804C000 and the ALi M3031 tuner at I2C 0x20 ("M3031" on UART), and starts its application tasks.

desc: Ferguson Ariva 53 official firmware V1.30B8 (2016-06-02) for the compact Full HD DVB-S2 satellite receiver on the single-CPU ALi C3503C SoC.
Earlier 2016 release alongside V1.33B7 (2019-08-13): uses bootloader chunk "HAS71" (39072-01047, 2016-05-06), maincode "V1.30B8*" at 0x130000, and osd_string at 0x590900.
